departments: Academic university departments with their building and budget
instructors: University teaching staff (professors) with their department and salary
students: Enrolled university students with CGPA, department and year of enrollment
courses: Courses offered, with course code, title, credits, department and the instructor who teaches it
enrollments: Which student took which course, with grade, grade point and semester (links students and courses)
customers: Online store customers with their city and country
products: Products for sale with category, unit price and stock quantity
orders: Customer orders with order date, total amount and status
order_items: Line items of each order: product, quantity and price per unit (links orders and products)
corp_departments: Corporate company departments with their office location
employees: Company employees with job title, department, hire date and salary
